title: LaCrosse 104-730 8" Dual Outdoor Clock & Thermometer
text: LaCrosse 104-730 8" Dual Outdoor Clock & Thermometer. Got this as a gift. Lasted a couple months. Then it rained. Never worked after that. So if you live in a place with no rain, this is for you.

product_metadata.title: La Crosse Technology 104-730 Dual Faced Outdoor Station Clock and Thermometer, 8"
description: Outdoor station gives you two views front & back featuring time & temperature. 8 inch dial in a metal, weather-resistant case mounted onto scroll powder-coated black metal wall bracket. Simple 1 AA alkaline battery (not included) operation.
